flavorText: A sudden earthquake rocked the city. Three properties took the hit.
Gunfire shattered the city's quiet evening. Chaos took its toll on everyone.

description: All players teleported to random positions
flavorText: The typhoon swept through, scattering everyone to new positions across the city.

description: Everyone rolls a single die for 4 rounds
flavorText: The neighboring country closed its borders. Goods and travelers slowed to a crawl — so does the city.
A scandal hit the headlines. The higher you climb, the easier you fall.
Tonight's spotlight belongs to those who give back. Kindness, it turns out, is also an investment.
An accident brought traffic to a standstill. Someone has to sit this one out.
A fortune appeared from nowhere. Nobody asked where it came from, but everyone's pockets got heavier.
The biggest bank in the neighboring city just went under. The panic spread along the trade routes.
The wealthy need to lift up those still climbing. Tonight, they finally do.
